## About
Alsip Truck Center is a diesel truck shop on S Pulaski Rd in Alsip. There is no job too big or too small. We work on Volvo, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Mack and all other major brands, from preventative maintenance to full engine overhauls.
While your truck is here you can fuel up at our diesel station, use the truck scale and finish with a truck wash. We also handle DOT yearly inspections and install every brand of electronic log book.
Drivers and fleet owners have given us a 4 star rating from 121 Google reviews. Customers mention Peter, Greg and Derek by name, and we work hard to get you back on the road making money.

## Services
- Preventative maintenance: Regular upkeep to keep your truck running smoothly.
- Diesel service: We diagnose the issue and work on all makes and models of diesel engines.
- DOT yearly inspections: Annual DOT inspections done in our shop.
- Truck wash: After your truck is fixed, get it washed so it looks as good as it runs.

## FAQ
Q: What brands of trucks do you work on?
A: All major brands, including Volvo, Peterbilt, Kenworth and Mack, and we service all makes and models of diesel engines.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Email us at atc@alsiptruckcenter.com for a free quote.

Q: Is there diesel fuel on site?
A: Yes. We have a diesel fuel station and a truck scale on site.
